newsitem.title: CROATIA: Rates mixed, volume up at Croatia bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Rates mixed, volume up at Croatia bill auction.

text.p: Rates were mixed and volume rose to 227.8 million kuna on Wednesday as Croatian banks placed more of their excess funds into central bank bills at a weekly auction.
The 91-day rate eased 50 basis points to 9.0 percent as the bank accepted all bids for 35.8 million kuna worth of its medium-term paper.
It sold 192 million kuna in 35-day bills at an unchanged 7.50 percent. The rate had dipped from a previous 8.0 percent last week.
The banks still stayed out of the longest-term, 182-day bills, last issued at 17.50 percent back in 1996.
